text: Aiscribe（DSH 插件，MCP 工具客户端）：汇总本机多种 AI 编程和聊天会话，生成日报与周报，也可加入 Windows 最近文件作为交付佐证。插件通过 MCP stdio 启动 sidecar，提供会话查询、报告生成保存和模板管理工具。用户可按日期筛选、按项目整理或裁剪素材，并输出 Markdown、Word、HTML；还可复用已有报告版式。适合需要整合分散 AI 工作记录的用户。本地模板无需云服务，选择 LLM 润色时需配置服务；DSH 包含 Windows x64 runtime。

Aiscribe turns local AI coding and chat sessions into daily or weekly reports. Its DSH MCP tools query sessions, generate and save reports, and manage templates. Users can filter by date, group by project, and export Markdown, Word, or HTML. Optional LLM polishing needs a configured provider.
想把我在不同 AI 编程工具里的工作记录汇总成日报。
能不能按项目整理多种 AI 助手的会话并生成周报？
我想把本地 AI 对话整理成 Markdown 或 Word 工作总结。
让 DSH 查询我的 AI 会话并帮我保存一份工作报告。
有没有办法把最近编辑过的文档也作为日报里的交付记录？
我想按时间筛选会话，还能剪掉不属于当天工作的片段。
I want to turn activity across my AI coding tools into a daily work report.
Can I group local AI chat sessions by project and export a weekly summary?
Aiscribe 的功能「多源会话汇总」：连接器读取本机多种 AI 编程和聊天工具的会话记录，按来源汇集查询；通过 MCP 的 list_sources 与 get_conversations 工具供客户端使用。
Aiscribe 的功能「按项目与时间生成报告」：报告生成流程将会话素材整理为项目和事项结构，可按日期或时间范围筛选，并输出可读的工作报告。
Aiscribe 的功能「多格式保存」：用户可将报告正文保存为 Markdown、DOCX 或 HTML；MCP 保存工具接受正文、文件名和格式参数。
Aiscribe 的功能「报告版式模板」：用户可列出、读取和保存报告格式模板，用已有报告样例提取版式并在后续输出中复用。
Aiscribe 可选的云端 LLM 润色会向所选服务发送待润色内容；不启用润色时可使用本地模板生成报告。

dsh-aireport README · Aiscribe · One-click work reports😄：Daily reports, weekly reports, quarterly reviews, year-end summaries — screw them all!!!!!
You really think your manager reads them closely? A pure waste of life!!! Pointless burning of brain cells!!!!!!
You're already working with AI — just let AI write the reports. Stop thinking about them!!!!!!
Broke? Then grab free eggs everywhere you can 🥚 — AI chat logs are scattered all over the place, and asking a single AI to write them can't even keep a consistent format or content. Now they're all pooled together and generated in one go!!!

dsh-aireport README · Aiscribe · One-click work reports😄：**Local-first, privacy-first.** Searches all AI coding/chat tool sessions on your own machine,
groups them by project, and turns them into daily/weekly reports (Markdown / Word / HTML) —
exposed to any AI client as an **MCP server**.

> The MCP tools fetch *every real message you sent today*; your AI assistant reads them and writes the report.
> That division of labour is why the output is far better than template-only reporting.

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

---

dsh-aireport README · Why：Your day is scattered across several AI tools: code edits in an IDE, debugging in a chat window,
design notes in another tool. When report time comes you reconstruct it from memory — mixed-up projects,
wrong dates, vague summaries.

Aiscribe splits the job into three steps:

dsh-aireport README · Why：1. **Read locally** — pull what you actually sent today from each tool's local database/logs, filtered by a
   single timezone (Asia/Shanghai). Nothing leaves your machine.
2. **Let the AI summarise** — hand the raw conversations to your AI assistant over MCP; it merges duplicates,
   distils *topics* (not messages), and groups them by project.
3. **Format and save** — emit a fixed `1、Project` / `①、Topic` layout with a **detailed version + a short version**,
   written to local `reports/` as md, docx, or a self-contained shareable html page.
dsh-aireport README · Why：No AI? The local template still produces a draft. The tool never pretends to summarise — a draft is labelled as a draft.

dsh-aireport README · Data in: 17 local sources：- **16 AI tool connectors** — CodeBuddy CN, TRAE, Codex, dsh, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, iFlow,
  Copilot Chat, Cline, Roo Code, Kilo Code, Cursor, Doubao, WorkBuddy, Kimi. Each reads the tool's own local
  files directly; no Cass-style indexer, no extra packages.
- **Document activity evidence (Windows)** — reads the system's "Recent items" list and adds the Word / Excel /
  PPT / Markdown files you touched today: AI sessions say *what you did*, file activity proves *what you delivered*.
  It reads file names, open times and document metadata, plus an optional **first-2,000-character preview** of
  `docx/xlsx/pptx/md/txt`, shown only on the local detail page (`AIREREPORT_RECENT_PREVIEW=0` disables it entirely).
- **Cached parsing** — Recent-file shortcuts are cached by file fingerprint, and previews by
  “path + mtime + size”, so unchanged files are never reopened. The cache lives in `<data dir>/cache/`,
  stays on this machine, and can be deleted at any time.

dsh-aireport README · Organise: by project and time, without bleed-through：- **Correct date filtering** — only sessions starting that day, or spanning the night (≤ 1 day); a week-old
  session touched once won't leak into today.
- **Automatic project grouping** — keyword rules (`projects.json`) → title hints → **cwd's last path segment**
  fallback; new projects need zero config.
- **Time trimming** — set a start/end per session in the guide page; segments outside the window are dropped
  **inside the tool** — `get_conversations` never returns them, so the AI cannot write them back in.
- **Pick what goes in** — everything is selected by default; anything you untick never reaches the material
  or the report.
section: Organise: by project and time, without bleed-through

text:
dsh-aireport README · Output: three formats, two paths：- **Three formats** — Markdown (default, easy to edit), Word (`--format docx`, hand-rolled WordprocessingML),
  and a shareable HTML page (`--format html`, one self-contained file: inline CSS, no JS, no external assets).
- **Local rendering** — offline, filtered by your ticks and trims, written straight into `reports/`.
- **Hand it to your AI** — copy a ready-to-paste instruction carrying the selected record ids and the format spec;
  the client AI reads the raw sessions and summarises, which gives the best quality.
- **Optional LLM polish** (`--llm`, DeepSeek-compatible, or local Ollama): the model may only rewrite each item's
  text. The report skeleton is machine-built and every reply must pass a structure/format check, otherwise it
  falls back to the template silently.
- **Format cloning** — upload the reports you already write (md / txt / docx / image); the layout is extracted
  locally into a template, and every later report reproduces your format — structure only, never the sample's content.

dsh-aireport README · Connect: MCP + DSH：- **MCP stdio** — 7 tools: `list_sources`, `get_conversations`, `generate_report`, `save_report`,
  `list_templates`, `get_format_spec`, `save_template`; TRAE, Claude Code, Cursor and dsh all work.
- **DSH plugin** — install **Aiscribe** (`dsh-aireport`) from the DSH plugin market; the package bundles a
  Windows sidecar, so **no Python install is required**. Start a new session and the agent has every tool.
  Source and standalone MCP setups still work.
- **Zero third-party dependencies (core)** — data access, report building and MCP run on the Python standard
  library alone. The one exception is the **guide page frontend**: `ui.py`'s server is still stdlib, but the
  page pulls Tailwind / React / Framer Motion / Babel from a public CDN, so the first load needs internet.
  Offline it shows an explicit notice pointing at the CLI or MCP instead of a blank page.

text:
dsh-aireport README · DSH plugin (no Python required)：Search for **Aiscribe** (`dsh-aireport`) in the DSH 0.2.x plugin market and install it, then **start a
new session**. Or use the CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-aireport
```

`0.2.0` bundles a **Windows x64** runtime only; macOS/Linux builds will ship as separate platform packages.
Reports and config live in `~/.aireport/`. See [`dsh-plugin/README.md`](dsh-plugin/README.md).

dsh-aireport README · Local guide page：```powershell
python -m ai_report ui            # port 5071, opens your browser
python -m ai_report ui --port 5080 --no-open
```

Bound to `127.0.0.1` only. Six screens: **splash → four steps → generating screen**.

dsh-aireport README · Local guide page：1. **Source radar** — lists only the tools really detected on this machine; each lights up after it is
   really read, tagged with its content level (full per-message text / titles only / metadata). Once
   scanning finishes the list is sorted by session count, and tools that are not installed are folded
   into a collapsed “N tools not detected” row.
2. **Time window** — daily (one day) / weekly (the natural week of a chosen day) / custom range.
3. **Session picking** — lanes per project, all selected by default; each session can also be cut to a
   time window with ✂.
4. **Template & output** — md / docx / html, plus format cloning from your old reports (md / txt / docx / image).
   Tick “reference document previews” if reports should include document text (Recent-files material only,
   first 160 characters, read locally).

dsh-aireport README · Local guide page：- **Generate report (local template by default)** — render and write the report into `reports/` locally,
  filtered by your ticks and trims. The page shows the file name, path and open/download links. Only if you
  **manually tick “AI polish”** and have an engine configured does the **draft text** (daily summaries plus,
  when available, up to 120 chars of the AI reply — not the full transcript) go to the model. The page states
  plainly whether the body was summarised or is still the raw template draft.
  **With no engine configured it does not pretend to summarise** — it falls back and says why.
- **Copy instruction** — paste the generated instruction (carrying the record ids you selected and the format
  spec) into your AI chat; the AI reads the raw sessions and summarises, which gives **the best quality**.
  In that path the file is written by your AI client via `save_report`.

dsh-aireport README · Browsing every past session：The wizard only shows the material for the day you picked. To browse **all** history, hit
**“浏览历史会话”** in the top-right corner, or open `http://127.0.0.1:5071/browse` directly:

dsh-aireport README · Browsing every past session：- filter by **source** (with real per-source counts) and by **project**; pick any date range
- the search box covers **titles, summaries and per-message text** (`/` to focus, `Esc` to close)
- click a row for a right-hand drawer with the **full per-message body, timestamps and project path**;
  sources that keep only titles/metadata are labelled “no body”, and Recent-files records show the
  locally extracted **document preview** instead
- deep links work: `/browse?id=dsh|session-xxxx`
- listing is cached for 30 s so paging/searching never re-scans the disk; **Refresh** forces a re-read

dsh-aireport README · Time trimming：A long session often mixes yesterday's leftovers with today's work. In the guide page click the ✂ button
on a session chip and set a start/end time. Everything outside that window is dropped **inside the tool** —
`get_conversations` simply never returns it, so the AI cannot write it back in. The preview and the material
handed to the AI stay in sync, and a `已剪辑` badge marks the chip (`清空全部剪辑` undoes everything).
Times are Beijing time; an end earlier than the start means an overnight window (e.g. `22:30 ~ 02:00`);
segments without a timestamp are always kept. Trims live in `<data dir>/trims.json` (the repo root when
running from source, `~/.aireport` when installed; override with `AIREREPORT_TRIMS`, gitignored).

dsh-aireport README · Format cloning：```powershell
python -m ai_report learn old-daily.md --name my-format   # learn from one sample
python -m ai_report learn a.md b.docx --name my-format    # several samples vote on the common layout
python -m ai_report templates                             # list what has been learned
python -m ai_report daily --date 2026-10-16 --template my-format

dsh-aireport README · Format cloning：- **Structure only** — title line, header line, project heading, item marker, TODO block, footer, dual
  version or not. The sample's actual work content is never carried over.
- **Image samples** — no OCR (keeps the zero-dependency rule). Images are archived and the host AI is asked
  to read them and write the structure back via the `save_template` MCP tool.
- **Two consumers** — the AI path (`get_format_spec` injects the spec into the prompt; primary) and the CLI
  path (`--template` styles the template-only output).
- Templates live in `templates/*.json` (override with `AIREREPORT_TEMPLATES_DIR`, gitignored); set
  `AIREREPORT_TEMPLATE` to choose which one is active by default.

dsh-aireport README · Summarisation engine (optional)：Summarisation only happens on the *already-collapsed draft* level: the draft is locally assembled
(e.g. CodeBuddy CN's real input timeline for the day, each entry capped at 400 chars) and may append up to
120 chars of the assistant's conclusion when one exists. It is **not the full transcript**, but it does
contain fragments of your own input — decide accordingly before enabling it. Configure it via a gitignored
`llm.json` or the matching environment variables:

dsh-aireport README · Summarisation engine (optional)：```json
{ "provider": "deepseek", "model": "deepseek-chat", "api_key": "sk-..." }
```

- **DeepSeek** — set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, or put it in `llm.json`
- **Nothing leaves the machine** — switch `"provider"` to `"ollama"` and point `"model"` at a model you have
  pulled locally (e.g. `qwen3.8:27b`); talks to `http://127.0.0.1:11434`, no key needed
- The CLI has the same switch: `python -m ai_report daily --llm` (falls back to the template on failure)

dsh-aireport README · MCP + Skill (recommended)：Client-by-client setup and known pitfalls (including TRAE's space-splitting `command`) live in
[`mcp/README.md`](mcp/README.md) (Chinese).

dsh-aireport README · How it works：```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph L1["L1 Connectors (local files only, offline)"]
        A1[CodeBuddy CN / TRAE] --> U[UnifiedRecord]
        A2[Codex / dsh / Claude Code] --> U

dsh-aireport README · How it works：| Layer | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| L1 connectors | Normalise each tool's raw data into `UnifiedRecord`; per-message text goes into `raw["messages"]` |
| L2 index | Merge/dedupe, project classification, **Asia/Shanghai “today + overnight ≤ 1 day” filtering** |
| L3 generation | Template rendering (`generate_report`) — no understanding, just listing; used for quick previews and as a fallback |
| Summarisation | Done by the client AI after `get_conversations` (**the key part of this design**) |
| L4 optional | LLM polish (`--llm`), Word / shareable HTML export |

dsh-aireport README · Report format：One file, two versions — detailed on top, a `---` separator, short version below.

```markdown

dsh-aireport README · AI 日报 2026-10-16：**汇报人：** 张三 ｜ **部门：** 算法组 ｜ **日期：** 2026年10月16日

> 数据来源：CodeBuddy CN 当日真实发送消息（127 条逐条输入）、TRAE 本地记忆、豆包（本地聚合，隐私优先）

**1、订单服务（重构下单链路，09:06–18:20）：**

①、接口契约梳理：确认 v2 字段清单并落成 contracts/order.md。

②、超时问题定位：定位到连接池配置过小，改为 20 后压测回归通过。

**2、数据看板：**

①、新增日活趋势图，支持按渠道筛选。

**3、待办事项：**

①、订单服务：连接池压测报告归档。

---

dsh-aireport README · AI 日报（简洁版）2026-10-16：**1、订单服务：**

①、接口契约梳理

②、超时问题定位

**2、数据看板：**

①、新增日活趋势图
```

Rules (hard-coded in the Skill): projects use `**1、Name：**`, topics use `①②③`; the short version drops
the parenthetical context and keeps **only the text before the `：`** of each detailed bullet.

dsh-aireport README · CLI：```powershell
python -m ai_report daily  [--date YYYY-MM-DD] [--llm] [--out FILE] [--format md|docx|html] [--template NAME]
python -m ai_report weekly [--date YYYY-MM-DD] [--template NAME]
python -m ai_report range  --start YYYY-MM-DD --end YYYY-MM-DD [--template NAME]
python -m ai_report sources

Windows helpers: [`scripts/run_daily.bat`](scripts/run_daily.bat) / [`scripts/run_weekly.bat`](scripts/run_weekly.bat);
scheduling example: [`automation_example.json`](automation_example.json).

dsh-aireport README · Supported sources：All connectors are native: they read each tool's own local files, so no Cass-style indexer and no extra
packages are needed. The only exception is zstd-compressed sessions (Codex, dsh): with `zstandard` installed
or a `zstd` binary on PATH you get the full text; without either they degrade to metadata-only — never an
error, never a crash.

dsh-aireport README · Full per-message text (best report quality)：| Source | Auto-discovered location | What is available locally |
|---|---|---|
| CodeBuddy CN | `%APPDATA%/CodeBuddy CN/` | Session metadata + **raw sent inputs via `onAgentStart: userInput=` in logs** (user side only) |
| TRAE | `~/.trae-cn/memory/projects/` | Per-message summaries + `topics.md` session summaries |
| Codex | `~/.codex/` | `state_5.sqlite` metadata + projected history / `rollout-*.jsonl.zst` user **and** assistant turns |
| dsh | `~/.dsh/sessions/` | Per-message user **and** assistant turns from the `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` event stream |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/projects/` | `**/*.jsonl` user/assistant turns (sidechains and local-command noise skipped) |
| Gemini CLI | `~/.gemini/tmp/*/chats/` | `session-*.json` user/model messages |
| Qwen Code | `~/.qwen/tmp/*/chats/` | Same format (Gemini CLI fork) |
| iFlow | `~/.iflow/tmp/*/chats/` | Same format (Gemini CLI fork) |
| Copilot Chat | `%APPDATA%/Code/User/workspaceStorage/*/chatSessions/` | VS Code built-in chat `*.jsonl`: prompt + response parts |
| Cline | `…/globalStorage/saoudrizwan.claude-dev/tasks/` | `api_conversation_history.json` user/a

dsh-aireport README · Full per-message text (best report quality)：Every message carries a `role`: `user` is what the person asked, `assistant` is what the AI concluded or
changed. “What was done” in a report comes from the `assistant` side — never rewrite the question into a
past-tense claim.

dsh-aireport README · Titles / metadata only (bodies live in the cloud)：| Source | Auto-discovered location | What is available locally |
|---|---|---|
| Doubao | `%LOCALAPPDATA%/Doubao/User Data/Default/IndexedDB` | Titles and timestamps (LevelDB / V8 blobs) |
| WorkBuddy | `~/.workbuddy/workbuddy.db` | Titles and timestamps (cwd is its own workspace dir) |
| Kimi | `%APPDATA%/kimi-desktop/` | Metadata + edited file paths (used to locate the project dir) |

dsh-aireport README · Configuration：| Env var | Purpose | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `AIREREPORT_HOME` | Data directory (reports, templates, config, trims, cache) | repo root from source; `~/.aireport` when installed |
| `AIREREPORT_REPORTS_DIR` | Report output directory | `<data dir>/reports` |
| `AIREREPORT_TEMPLATES_DIR` | Learned format templates directory | `<data dir>/templates` |
| `AIREREPORT_TEMPLATE` | Default active format template | newest learned template |
| `AIREREPORT_TRIMS` | Session time-trim file | `<data dir>/trims.json` |
| `AIREREPORT_PROJECTS` | Project classification rules | `<repo>/projects.json`, then `~/.aireport/projects.json`, then built-ins + cwd fallback |
| `CODEBUDDY_CN_DB` … `VSCODE_GLOBAL_STORAGE` | Override a source path (multi-dir values use `;`) | Auto-discovered |
| `AIREREPORT_SCAN_ALL_USERS` | Set `1` to also read **other Windows users'** session dirs on this machine | Off — other people's sessions are not read by default |
| `AIREREPORT_RECENT_DIR` `AIREREPORT_RECENT_EXTS` `AIREREPORT_RECENT_EXCLUDE` | Recent-items dir / extension whitelist (`;` or `,` separated) / excluded path prefixes (`;` separated) | Auto-discovered `Recent`; extensions
dsh-aireport README · Configuration：Copy [`projects.example.json`](projects.example.json) to `projects.json` to pin your own project names.

dsh-aireport README · Privacy：- Connectors read local files only and never go online; Aiscribe has no telemetry and does not upload
  sessions on its own
- **Tool output enters the model context.** When a cloud model drives the report through MCP,
  `get_conversations(detail="full")` is effectively sending those transcripts to that model provider.
  The server tells models to start with `detail="summary"` and to read only the projects/dates needed
- Only the **current user's** directories are read; other users on the same machine require
  `AIREREPORT_SCAN_ALL_USERS=1`
- The **Recent files** connector reads Windows Recent shortcuts, document metadata (`docProps/core.xml`),
  and by default a **first-2,000-character preview** of `docx/xlsx/pptx/md/txt`, shown only in the local
  detail page. Previews are not included in MCP responses; a report includes the first 160 characters only
  when you tick "reference document previews". Set `AIREREPORT_RECENT_PREVIEW=0` to never open documents.
  Reports show full paths by default; set `AIREREPORT_RECENT_BASENAME=1` to hide directories or
  `AIREREPORT_RECENT_EXCLUDE` to skip sensitive folders
- Parse caches (lnk targets and previews) live i

dsh-aireport README · Known limitations：- **Most sources are re-read on every collection**: a couple of hundred local records typically finish
  within a second. The time sits in the pure-Python parsing of dsh, CodeBuddy CN and Doubao (a thread pool
  measured 1.01x — GIL-bound, so it is not used). Recent files caches lnk targets by file fingerprint and
  previews by path + mtime + size; persistent caching for the other connectors is **not implemented yet**.
- **Assistant text is not available everywhere**: CodeBuddy CN only reconstructs user inputs; WorkBuddy,
  Kimi and Doubao keep titles only. Those sources can only contribute “what was asked”.
- **Codex / dsh need zstd**: with `zstandard` or a `zstd` binary you get the text, otherwise the connector
  degrades to metadata.
- **Document previews are excerpts**: the first 2,000 characters by default, and legacy `.doc/.xls/.ppt`
  files are not opened at all.

text:
dsh-aireport README · 为什么需要它：一天的工作散落在好几个 AI 工具里：在 IDE 里改代码、在助手对话框里排查、在另一个工具里画方案。
到了写日报的时候靠回忆拼凑，结果是**项目混在一起、时间对不上、内容泛泛而谈**。

Aiscribe 把这件事拆成三步：

1. **本地取数**：从每个 AI 工具留在本机的会话数据库 / 日志里，按**北京时间**取出你当天真实发出的内容（不联网、不上传）；
2. **交给 AI 归纳**：通过 MCP 把原始对话交给正在给你干活的 AI，由它合并同类项、提炼成事项、按项目归类；
3. **格式化落盘**：按固定的 `1、项目名：` `①、事项` 格式输出**详细版 + 简洁版**，写成本地 md / docx / 可分享 HTML。

不想接 AI 也没问题：本机模板可以直接出一份草稿。工具不会假装“归纳”，草稿就是草稿。

dsh-aireport README · 取数：17 个本机数据源，一个都不少：- **16 个 AI 工具连接器**：CodeBuddy CN、TRAE、Codex、dsh、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、iFlow、
  Copilot Chat、Cline、Roo Code、Kilo Code、Cursor、豆包、WorkBuddy、Kimi；全部直接读本地文件，不需要 Cass 之类的索引器。
- **文档活动佐证（Windows）**：读取系统「最近打开」，把当天动过的 Word / Excel / PPT / Markdown 补进报告——
  AI 会话里说「做了什么」，文件活动证明「交出了什么」。可取完整路径、打开时间、文档元数据，
  并可选读 `docx / xlsx / pptx / md / txt` 的**正文摘录**（默认前 2000 字，仅本机详情页可见；
  设 `AIREREPORT_RECENT_PREVIEW=0` 可完全关闭，不再打开任何文档）。
- **解析结果有缓存**：最近文件的快捷方式按文件指纹缓存，正文摘录按「路径 + 修改时间 + 大小」缓存，
  文件没变就不会重复打开。缓存落在 `<数据目录>/cache/`，只在本机，删掉即可清空。

dsh-aireport README · 整理：按项目、按时间，不串味：- **正确的时间过滤**：只收“当天开始”或“跨夜不超过 1 天”的会话；一周前只被碰过一次的旧会话不会混进今天。
- **项目自动归类**：关键词规则（`projects.json`）→ 标题关键词 → **cwd 路径末段目录名兜底**，新项目不用改配置。
- **时间剪辑**：在引导页给单条素材设起止时间，窗口外的片段**由工具直接丢弃**——`get_conversations` 根本不会返回它，
  AI 也就没机会再写回报告。
- **素材可勾选**：默认全选；取消勾选的记录不会进入素材，也就不会出现在报告里。

dsh-aireport README · 产出：三种格式，两条路径：- **三种格式**：Markdown（默认，便于二次编辑）、Word（`--format docx`，纯标准库手写 WordprocessingML）、
  可分享 HTML（`--format html`，自包含单文件：样式内嵌、无脚本、无外部资源，双击即可打开）。
- **本机出稿**：不联网，按你的勾选、剪辑与模板直接写进 `reports/`。
- **交给 AI**：复制一段带记录 id 与格式规范的指令，让客户端 AI 读原文归纳，**质量最高**。
- **可选 LLM 归纳**：`--llm` 走 DeepSeek（OpenAI 兼容端点），也支持本机 Ollama。模型**只能改写每个条目的文字**，
  报告骨架（标题、项目分节、条目顺序）由本机程序生成，返回结果还要过结构 / 格式校验，不过就退回纯模板，绝不中断。
- **格式克隆**：上传你以前一直用的日报（md / txt / docx / 图片），本机抽出排版结构存成模板，
  之后每份报告都复现你原来的格式——只学排版，不搬内容。

dsh-aireport README · 本地引导页：1. **数据源雷达**：只列本机**真实检测到**的工具，逐个扫描、读完才亮，并标注每个源的内容等级

   想让报告带上文档正文时，勾选「报告引用文档正文摘录」（仅最近文件素材，最多 160 字，本机读取）。

dsh-aireport README · 本地引导页：- **生成报告（默认本机纯模板）**：先在本机按你的勾选与剪辑过滤素材、用模板渲染，直接写进 `reports/`；
  页面给出文件名、路径与打开 / 下载链接。只有你**手动勾选「AI 归纳」**且配置了归纳引擎时，
  才会把**草稿文本**（当日摘要，有 AI 正文时附最多 120 字的结论片段，不是完整对话）交给模型改写；
  页面会明确标注「正文已由 xxx 归纳」还是「未归纳，仍是草稿」。
  **未配置归纳引擎时不会假装归纳**，而是如实退回草稿并说明原因。
- **复制指令**：把带 `ids` 与格式规范的指令贴进你的 AI 对话，由 AI 读原文归纳，**质量最高**；
  这种情况下的落盘由你的 AI 客户端调用 `save_report` 完成。

dsh-aireport README · 浏览历史会话：引导页只展示「你选的那一天」的素材。想翻**全部历史会话**，点右上角的
**「浏览历史会话」**，或直接打开 `http://127.0.0.1:5071/browse`：

- 左栏按**数据源**（含各自真实条数）和**项目**筛选，日期区间可任选；
- 顶部搜索框同时搜**标题、摘要和逐条正文**（按 `/` 聚焦，`Esc` 关详情）；
- 点任意一条，右侧抽屉展示该会话的**逐条正文 + 时间 + 项目路径**；
  只有标题 / 元数据的源会明确标注「无正文」；最近文件则展示本机读取的**文档摘录**；
- 支持深链接：`/browse?id=dsh|session-xxxx` 直接打开某条会话；
- 列表读取有 30 秒缓存（翻页、搜索不用反复扫硬盘），点「刷新」强制重读。

dsh-aireport README · 时间剪辑：一条长会话常常把昨天没干完的事和今天的活混在一起。在引导页点素材右侧的 **✂**，
设「从 / 到」两个时间点：窗口外的对话片段**由工具自己丢掉**——`get_conversations` 根本不会返回它，
AI 也就没机会再写回报告。预览骨架与交给 AI 的素材同步生效，chip 上会打「已剪辑」标记，
右上角的「清空全部剪辑」可一键撤销。时间为北京时间；「到」早于「从」按跨夜处理（如 `22:30 ~ 02:00`）；
没有时间戳的片段一律保留。剪辑存在数据目录的 `trims.json`（源码运行时是仓库根，安装态是
`~/.aireport`；可用 `AIREREPORT_TRIMS` 覆盖，已 gitignore）。

dsh-aireport README · 格式克隆：- **只抽结构**：标题行 / 头部信息行 / 项目行 / 事项行 / 待办段 / 收尾注 / 是否双版本，
  **不留样例里的具体工作内容**；
- **图片样例**：本机不做识图（保持零依赖），只存档并给出提示，让 AI 读图后用 MCP `save_template` 回填结构；
- **两种消费方式**：AI 路径（`get_format_spec` 把规范塞进提示词，主力）/ CLI 路径（`--template` 直接排版）；

它**不是完整对话**，但其中确实含有你原始输入的片段——开启归纳前请确认可以接受这一点。

flowchart LR
    subgraph L1["L1 连接器层（只读本地文件，不联网）"]
        A1[CodeBuddy CN / TRAE] --> U[UnifiedRecord]

| 层 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| L1 连接器 | 把每个工具的原始数据归一化为 `UnifiedRecord`；能拿到逐条原文的塞进 `raw["messages"]` |

| L3 生成 | 模板渲染（`generate_report`）——不含理解，只罗列，用于快速查看与兜底 |
| 归纳 | 由客户端 AI 通过 `get_conversations` 拿到素材后完成（**这套方案的关键**） |

①、接口契约梳理：确认 v2 字段清单并落成 contracts/order.md。

②、超时问题定位：定位到连接池配置过小，改为 20 后压测回归通过。

**2、数据看板：**

**3、待办事项：**

①、订单服务：连接池压测报告归档。

---

①、接口契约梳理

②、超时问题定位

**2、数据看板：**

```

dsh-aireport README · 支持的数据源：全部连接器都是**原生实现**——直接读各家工具自己的本地文件，不需要安装 Cass 之类的索引器，也不需要额外装包。

报告里的「做了什么」来自 `assistant` 侧，不是把用户的问句改写成完成态。
section: 有逐条正文（报告质量最高）

dsh-aireport README · 配置：| 环境变量 | 用途 | 缺失时行为 |
|---|---|---|
| `AIREREPORT_HOME` | 数据目录（报告 / 模板 / 配置 / 剪辑 / 缓存） | 源码运行时为仓库根；安装态或 sidecar 为 `~/.aireport` |
| `AIREREPORT_REPORTS_DIR` | 报告输出目录 | 默认 `<数据目录>/reports` |
| `AIREREPORT_TEMPLATES_DIR` | 格式模板存放目录 | 默认 `<数据目录>/templates` |
| `AIREREPORT_TEMPLATE` | 默认生效的格式模板名 | 不设则用最新学到的模板 |
| `AIREREPORT_TRIMS` | 引导页时间剪辑文件 | 默认 `<数据目录>/trims.json` |
| `AIREREPORT_PROJECTS` | 项目分类规则文件 | 依次找 `<仓库>/projects.json`、`~/.aireport/projects.json`，都没有则用内置规则 + cwd 兜底 |
| `CODEBUDDY_CN_DB` `WORKBUDDY_DB` `DOUBAO_IDB_DIR` `KIMI_DIR` `TRAE_ROOTS` `TRAE_MEMORY_DIR` `CODEX_DIR` `DSH_SESSIONS_DIR` `CLAUDE_CODE_DIR` `GEMINI_DIR` `QWEN_CODE_DIR` `IFLOW_DIR` `CURSOR_DB` `VSCODE_USER_DIRS` `VSCODE_GLOBAL_STORAGE` | 覆盖数据源路径（多目录型用 `;` 分隔） | 用自动发现的默认路径 |
| `AIREREPORT_SCAN_ALL_USERS` | 设 `1` 才会读**同机其他 Windows 用户**的会话目录 | 默认关闭（别人的会话不该被默认读进来） |
| `AIREREPORT_RECENT_DIR` `AIREREPORT_RECENT_EXTS` `AIREREPORT_RECENT_EXCLUDE` | 最近文件目录 / 扩展名白名单（`;` 或 `,` 分隔）/ 排除的目录前缀（`;` 分隔） | 自动发现 `Recent`；扩展名默认 `doc;docx;xls;xlsx;ppt;pptx;md;txt`；默认不排除 |
| `AIREREPORT_RECENT_BASENAME` | 设 `1` 时报告只显示文件名 | 默认显示完整路径 |
| `AIREREPORT_RECENT_PREVIEW` | 设 `0` 关闭最近文件的正文摘录（完全不开文档） | 默认开启，只读前 20

dsh-aireport README · 隐私声明：- 连接器**只读取本机文件、不联网**；Aiscribe 自身没有遥测，也不会主动上传会话；
- **但工具返回的内容会进入模型上下文**：用 MCP 让云端模型生成报告时，
  `get_conversations(detail="full")` 的对话原文等同于发送给该模型提供商。
  服务端已提示模型先用 `detail="summary"` 摸底，只读取与当前请求相关的项目与日期；
- 默认只读**当前用户**的目录；同机其他用户的会话要显式设 `AIREREPORT_SCAN_ALL_USERS=1` 才会碰；
- 「最近文件」连接器默认会本地读取 `docx/xlsx/pptx/md/txt` 的**前 2000 字正文摘录**，仅用于本机详情页；
  不会把摘录写进 MCP 返回，也不会自动进报告——只有你在引导页勾选「报告引用文档正文摘录」时才带前 160 字。
  设 `AIREREPORT_RECENT_PREVIEW=0` 可完全不开文档；报告默认显示完整路径，可用 `AIREREPORT_RECENT_BASENAME=1`
  隐藏目录，或用 `AIREREPORT_RECENT_EXCLUDE` 排除敏感目录；
- 解析缓存（lnk 目标与正文摘录）写在 `<数据目录>/cache/`，只在本机；删除该目录即可清空；
- 只有用户主动开启 AI 归纳（UI 勾选 / `--llm` / `polish=true`）时，**骨架草稿文本**才会发往所配的 LLM 端点；
  完整原始对话不会由归纳器直接发送；
- 报告只写到本地 `reports/`；MCP 的 HTTP 模式与引导页都只监听 `127.0.0.1`；
- 引导页 / 浏览页会校验 `Host` 与 `Origin`：只接受回环地址且同源的请求，挡掉 DNS rebinding
  （把域名解析到 127.0.0.1 再让网页打本地端口的攻击）；
- `.gitignore` 已排除 `reports/`、`projects.json`、`trims.json`、`dingtalk_config.json`、`automation.json`、`cache/`，避免个人内容误入库。

dsh-aireport README · 已知限制：- **多数数据源仍每次重读**：本机约 200 条记录通常 1 秒内读完。耗时集中在 dsh、CodeBuddy CN、豆包
  的纯 Python 解析上（实测线程并发只有 1.01x，受 GIL 限制，所以没做）。「最近文件」已按
  lnk 文件指纹缓存解析结果、并按「路径 + mtime + 大小」缓存正文摘录；其余连接器的持久化
  缓存**尚未实现**。
- **assistant 正文不是每个源都有**：CodeBuddy CN 只从日志还原用户输入；WorkBuddy / Kimi / 豆包
  本地只有标题。这几类源在报告里只能贡献「问过什么」。
- **Codex / dsh 需要 zstd**：装了 `zstandard` 或系统有 `zstd` 才能读正文，否则自动退化为元数据。
- **文档摘录不是全文**：默认只读前 2000 字，且 `.doc/.xls/.ppt` 老格式不读正文。
